original.label: Original 20,000-row block sample
original.selection: 200 equal-size index strata; one seeded random contiguous 100-row block per stratum. Descriptive block sample, not independent random conversations. No population prevalence estimates.

definitions.unit: One released row; not a distinct person or a deduplicated conversation.
definitions.percentage_points: Original minus census, random minus census, or original minus random as labeled.
definitions.total_variation_distance: One half of the summed absolute category-proportion differences; range 0 to 1.
definitions.interval_method: Approximate pointwise 95% Wilson score interval with finite-population variance correction, conditional on the stated denominator; SRS without replacement only. No uncertainty interval is assigned to census or original block-sample counts.
definitions.exact_vs_estimated: Census metadata, word lengths and literal group-template flags are exact for this pinned release. Rich regex flags were recomputed only in the random reference; original flags are retained.
definitions.sampling_uncertainty: Only random-reference proportions have intervals. Classification validity, dataset selection, and original block-sample dependence are separate issues.
definitions.comparison_policy: No p-value or arbitrary effect-size threshold determines whether the original sample is representative. Inspect magnitude and changes to the substantive interpretation.

model_by_year.definition: Each cell supplies both within-year family share and joint year/family share of all rows.

lengths.definition: Whitespace-delimited words summed over all stored messages of each role per row.
lengths.eligibility: Source-English-labeled rows with no truncated cells; no deduplication.
lengths.quantile_method: Linear interpolation at (n - 1) × q, identical to NumPy's default linear quantiles.
lengths.histogram_definition: Shared integer bins from quarter-decades of log10(1 + words); lower inclusive, upper exclusive; final bin unbounded.
lengths.ecdf_definition: Exact cumulative counts at common plotted thresholds; maximum ECDF gaps use every distinct observed word count.

repetition.definition: Source conversation_hash equality; no assertion that all full-corpus equal-hash rows were checked for byte-identical dialogue.
repetition.warning: Within-scope duplicate fractions depend on sample size and selection design. They are not directly comparable estimates of corpus duplication.

largest_differences.meaning: Largest observed percentage-point differences; no claim of proven sampling bias or statistical significance.

old_sample_verification.meaning: Original cached row offsets are compared with the immutable shard rows, including conversation hash and base features. Zero mismatches supports using this census as the original sample's frame.

overlap.interpretation: Natural overlap is retained; the reference was sampled from the entire release.
